text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking a break in the lounge, my 
eyes met those of a fellow trainer. For 
some reason, they had a rather stern look 
on their face.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Ah... hello.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the race adjustments were getting 
on everyone's nerves... Lately, the air in 
the trainer lounge had been strangely 
heavy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Mega Good Fortune!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through the lounge window, I could see two 
horse girls. They were too far away to 
hear what they were saying... but it was 
quite an unusual pair.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: And so, pretty please☆ Gimlet-san!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Summoning me for destruction and rebirth 
is wise indeed. Very well, I shall show 
you. Dwell within my legs, hammer of 
thunder!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—CRACK!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Gimlet-san! With this, we can 
deliver the ultimate luck!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, it is too early to rejoice. Rebirth 
must follow destruction!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right on☆ Catch that fortune with the 
fence so it won't escape! Now the 
trainers' luck is completely secure!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, be reborn by my hands. O fence that 
watches over the trainer lounge!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—It is complete. Now then, in what color 
shall we dye it? The black of the 
Underworld King, or the red of the 
phoenix...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Looking from the lounge, this is Zhen, 
which means East. It's the direction of 
the rising sun, representing health and 
vitality—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yup... this spot has got to be red!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
For the trainer lounge, this color is the 
best right now. This will get the qi 
flowing—and turn the luck around!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's boost their work and health luck 
with a bright, popping red☆ That'll 
definitely cheer the trainers up!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Transforming fortune... Eastern wisdom 
defying the goddess of fate, is it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaahahahaha!! Intriguing. Shall we outwit 
the goddess of fate together?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: We shall dye it in the phoenix's red!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's add flower decorations too! It hides 
the flaws☆ It soothes the eyes☆ Because it 
brings happiness to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: D... Did you see that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: They suddenly smashed the fence...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Then fixed the fence...

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text:
And then decorated the fixed 
fence............?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, ahahaha! That sums it up perfectly. 
...Come to think of it, the girl I'm 
training—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that fence (?) serving as a 
conversation starter, before we knew it, 
the lounge was filled with cheerful 
chatter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after that incident. A red 
handkerchief was lying in the hallway. As 
I picked it up and brushed off the dust...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There it is, my handkerchief! Thanks 
for picking it up!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I almost lost one out of my 50 colors of 
handkerchiefs~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I almost lost one out of my 50 colors of 
handkerchiefs~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Lucky colors come in tons of 
varieties! Honestly, I'd want 5,000 
colors, but that'd cause trouble for my 
roommate, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She really is full of mysteries, I 
thought to myself.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! I'd be in huge trouble! Picking out 
my lucky color handkerchief is my daily 
routine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words, so typical of a schoolgirl, 
brought a warm smile to my face.
